title: Planner: tab support in Teams shared and private channels for GCC, GCC High and DoD
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, enabled-by-default tab, licensing background and documented controls are supported. One clarification should acknowledge that Microsoft's Teams service description still lists shared channels as unavailable in GCC High and DoD, while its developer documentation describes government-cloud tab support.

claims.claim: The private-channels admin page still states that private channels do not support Planner tabs.
claims.quote: Private channels don't support connectors and tabs in Stream, Planner, Tasks by Planner and To Do, and Forms.

claims.claim: The Teams service description still says Planner cannot currently be accessed in private channels.

claims.claim: Planner is absent from the shared-channels page's supported-app list in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner shared private channels GCC GCC High DoD licensing price meter rollout. Opened shared-channels and read its complete Supported apps in shared channels list; Planner was not listed.

claims.claim: Planner is already available as a tab in standard Teams channels.
claims.quote: Users can access Planner as an app on the left side of Teams and as a tab in a channel within individual teams.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether existing plans can be attached to shared or private channels or only new plans created.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner shared private channels existing plans; Planner shared private channel tabs attach existing plan new plan. Read tab-disable article and Planner service description; existing plans created in channels are mentioned, not attaching pre-existing plans.

claims.claim: Shared and private channel membership can differ from parent-team membership.
claims.quote: Channel membership can be limited to a subset of the host team ... Shared and private channels ... Only members you add to the channel can participate in shared and private channels.

claims.claim: Only members added to a private channel can participate in it.
claims.quote: Only members of private channels can see and participate in private channels that they're added to.

claims.claim: Only members added to a shared channel can participate in it.
claims.quote: Only members of shared channels can see and participate in shared channels that they're added to.

claims.claim: People outside the organisation can participate in shared channels through Microsoft Entra B2B direct connect.
claims.quote: you can invite people outside your organization to participate in a shared channel by using Microsoft Entra B2B direct connect.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure and Security & identity; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Access to a channel-contained plan follows the channel's membership.
claims.quote: Plans can be inside other types of containers, like a Meeting or a Channel, and will use the membership defined by those containers.

claims.claim: Container members can generally create, update and delete tasks.
claims.quote: Generally, the members of a container can create, update, and delete the tasks in the plan.

claims.claim: Business Scenarios API customizations can further restrict those task actions.
claims.quote: It's possible to further restrict this via customizations through the Business Scenarios API.

claims.claim: Invite external users to shared channels governs invitations to external participants.
claims.quote: When On, owners and members of shared channels can invite external participants from organizations where a cross-organization trust has been configured.

claims.claim: For basic plans, the Planner admin page says task attachments are stored in the group's SharePoint location.
claims.quote: Basic plans and the tasks in them ... Attachments on these types of tasks are stored in the SharePoint location for the group.

claims.claim: Private channels have their own SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: Each private channel has its own SharePoint site.

claims.claim: Shared channels have their own SharePoint sites.

claims.claim: The particular SharePoint site used for channel-tab plan attachments is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner channel attachments stored; Planner shared private channels attachments storage channel container. Read Planner security, manage-planner-app, FAQ storage excerpt and Teams channel storage guidance; none identifies this plan's attachment site.

claims.claim: Planner users authenticate through Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: Users authenticate via Microsoft Entra ID

claims.claim: Access to each Planner plan is defined by its container.

claims.claim: The Planner app on Teams mobile has limited functionality.
claims.quote: There's limited functionality when using the Planner app on Teams mobile. On mobile, users will only see plans that are added to a tab in a channel within a team.

claims.claim: Teams channel policies govern channel creation, rather than being plan-user prerequisites or a Planner-tab switch.
claims.quote: Create private channels: When On, team owners and members can create private channels. ... Create shared channels: When On, team owners can create shared channels.

claims.claim: No government-cloud rollout window beyond the roadmap's January CY2027 target is published in the available evidence.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner tab shared private channels government cloud GCC license pricing rollout January 2027. Read roadmap, tab-disable article and government-related search excerpts; no government Planner-tab rollout window was found.

claims.claim: The shared-channels page says several supported apps are unavailable in DoD and GCC High.
claims.quote: Several of these apps are not available in DOD and GCCH environments.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowTeamsChannelContainerAccess $false disables Planner tabs in shared and private channels tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Open PowerShell and run the following command to disable the Planner tab for shared and private channels in your tenant. ... Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowTeamsChannelContainerAccess $false

claims.claim: Disabling the channel-tab experience blocks access to existing channel-created plans.

claims.quote: If you change your mind and want to enable the Planner tab for shared and private channels in your tenant, run the following command: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowTeamsChannelContainerAccess $true

claims.claim: The organisation-wide Planner disable page is addressed to a global admin.
claims.quote: If you're a global admin and you want to turn off Microsoft Planner for your organization, you can use Windows PowerShell.

claims.claim: Disabling the channel-tab experience prevents creation of new plans in shared and private channels.

claims.claim: The Planner admin page directs administrators to custom app permission policies to allow or block Planner for specific users.
claims.quote: To allow or block specific users in your organization from using Planner, make sure Planner is turned on for your organization on the Manage apps page, and then create a custom policy for app permissions and assign it to those users.

claims.claim: Teams policy edits or assignments may take 24 hours to take effect.
claims.quote: After you edit the global policy or assign a policy, it may take 24 hours for changes to take effect.

claims.claim: The Teams policies page says organisation-available Teams apps are also available in shared channels with Create shared channels on.
claims.quote: Create shared channels: When On, team owners can create shared channels. Teams apps that are available for your organization are also available in shared channels.

claims.quote: To turn off Planner for your organization, search for the Planner app, select it, and then select Block. ... To allow or block specific users ... make sure Planner is turned on for your organization

claims.claim: External channel members may see a plan contained in their shared channel.
